assumptionNotice: All vehicle, actuator and fan parameters are explicit teaching assumptions. This is parameter search for a designed feedback controller, not a learned neural pilot. Reference paths are targets; every exported flight frame comes from force/torque integration. Success applies only to this simplified model, not to Tesla or a real vehicle.

config.notice: 条件可行性仿真，不是Tesla实测。24 m为等价场地构造、20 m为倒悬起高假设，不能称为官方跳距或跳高。

vehicle.height_notice: 1.20m是原型侧视轮胎下缘复核后的比例假设，不是Tesla公布规格。旧1.35m保留在历史记录。

actuator.description: 假设双向六轴等效喷口分配器；平动力和力偶共用总喷力/耗气预算，不代表 Tesla 10 喷口的可达力矩集合。
actuator.virtual_nozzle_notice: 18 个理想虚拟喷口仅把等效力/力矩严格分解，不是 Tesla 喷口数量、布局或方向的复原。

landing.success_notice: 成功仅指接触瞬间的姿态、质心/接地点速度与位置容差达标；不模拟真实轮胎、悬架冲击或着地后稳定。

flat_kickflip.geometry_notice: 24 m = 14.1 m 示例车列 + 4.1 m 假设车长 + 两端各2.9 m余量。不是官方跳距；沿+X飞是镜像等价任务。 参照车前脸共面 y=-3m，Roadster飞行轴 y=0；相对前脸+3m的深度偏置纯属场地假设。
flat_kickflip.obstacle_dimension_notice: 参考车宽与人工定位用于场地等价；未提供公开精确尺寸者尤其Semi长度与Cybercab尺寸采用明示示例，非实测3D场地。

evaluation.notice: 22–28 m及车列间距缩放只做构造场地敏感性，不是官方射程置信区间。

gas_delivery.notice: 假设前70%气量可保持调压流量，最后30%按理想多方降压与冷却衰减。罐压、调压能力、喷口面积均未知，本关系不是Tesla实测。

flat_kickflip.method: Task-conditioned CEM over bounded feedback/reference parameters

inverted_release.method: Task-conditioned CEM over bounded feedback/reference parameters

attitude_recovery.method: Task-conditioned CEM over bounded feedback/reference parameters

units.pos: m, center of mass, z up

reachability.interpretation: Success grid for this trained policy and these finite sampled cases. A failed cell is not a mathematical impossibility proof; a successful cell is not a proof for every orientation or disturbance.

necessaryConditions: Initial body geometry must clear the ground.
Finite downward stopping distance and actuator lag require positive clearance.
The reported rotation-time bounds assume isolated full torque and zero initial angular velocity; shared lift/gas limits can only increase the required time.
Arbitrary attitude at arbitrary low height is not guaranteed, even with perfect control.

pressureSensitivity.notice: Same trained policies and identical held-out initial cases, without retraining; a failure does not prove a different policy cannot succeed.

numerics.notice: Same final policies and same held-out initial states; no retraining at smaller integration steps.
